adapter.description: GL Reserve Journal Feed: reads RSVMOVE records for Group Ledger. Records that fail validation are written to an exception queue and reported in the morning operations report.
CDW Reserve Fact Load: reads RSVMOVE records for Claims Data Warehouse. Schema violations are rejected at the boundary rather than corrected downstream.
Reserve Cession Feed: reads RSVMOVE records for ReCede. Where possible, partial deliveries are not forwarded; the consumer waits for a complete, reconciled set.
Reserve Movement Kafka Bridge: reads RSVMOVE records for Event Streaming Platform. Schema violations are rejected at the boundary rather than corrected downstream.

operationalNotes.note: Keep the incident bridge informed at regular intervals while a critical job is down. Before restarting, confirm with the Batch Scheduler that no dependent job has started. Abends caused by data are handed to the development team with the failing key.

Schema violations are rejected at the boundary rather than corrected downstream. Operators should capture the job log and the input dataset name before escalating. Partial deliveries are not forwarded; the consumer waits for a complete, reconciled set.

Operators should capture the job log and the time of failure before escalating. Duplicate detection relies on the business key, so the target rejects repeated keys. Schema violations are rejected at the boundary rather than corrected downstream.
INC-2024-0243 (2024-04-01): the MQ channel to Group Ledger stopped after network maintenance when the channel retry limit was reached; channel status is now part of the morning checks.
